l.i: doctor Parisiensis, scripsit contra Minoritas lib. 2[?]. Cui per Apologiam respondit Bonaventura Franciscanorum generalis. Et hic Parmae per sanguinolentos illos dicitur esse combustus. Desiderius Longobardus de statu monachorum hoc tempore disputabit: & quod deberent de manuum suarum labore vivere, librum edidit: & istum Thomas Aquinas hæresiarchum esse dicebat; ex Bernardo Luzenburgo. Philippus, scholae Parisiensis cancellarius, ac doctor theologus, contra eosdem fra-tres praedicabat, ut habet Thomas Cantipratensis. Guido Bonatus, Italus, astrologus apud forum Livij natus, scripsit contra Minoritas lib. 1. Caba-fila quidam, contra Thomam Aquinatem, calamum quoq; strinxit. Marsfredum Sicilie regem excommunicabat Papa, quia libros habebat adver-sus fratrum mendicitatem: Fasciculus temporum. Unde Ioannes Hussius, tom. 2 suorum operum: Magistri Parisienses (inquit) spiritu Iesu plura in duobus libris praedixerunt, quam possunt in Ecclesia Iesu reperiri, etc. Anno Domini 1260 Carmelitae fratres, vifis populorum odijs ac scandalis adver-sus Praedicatores & Minores, officia inquisitio-nis & exequutionis causarum cum cura Monialium á se excutiunt: Ex quadam bulla Alexandri quarti, Propterea pauciores semper erant Ca-

page.notes: Three small "?"-shaped marks stand in the left margin beside the lines "gifiri", "bus libris" and "lefu reperiri". They look like handwriting or manuscript annotation, not printed text, so they are left out. Ink underlining runs under several words ("Desiderius Longobardus", "Marsfredum Sicilie regem", "Fasciculus temporum", "Anno Domini 1260", "Propterea pauciores semper erant"); it is handwriting and is left out. The whole running text looks set in italic type, so it is marked as one italic paragraph; the roman/italic division is not certain. The last word is hyphenated "Ca-" and the catchword "dinal" is only partly legible. The "2" after "lib." is doubtful. "Caba-fila" keeps the printed hyphen at the line end and may be a line-break error. "Hussius" reads long s as printed s. Show-through from the reverse side is present but not transcribed.
